fields.label: Normalized ruling
fields.value: Body Unit is an architectural scale at `Architecture.Scale.BodyUnit`. One Rabbit, one Squirrel, or two Mice constitute one Body Unit. fields.label: Equal-personhood rule
fields.value: Two Mice in one Body Unit remain two complete equal Citizens. Each retains individual identity, personal items where their owners allow them, relationships, wounds, adversity, memory, Tale, recovery, and death. Body-unit equivalency is never half-personhood.

fields.value: Body Unit does not make every species number identical. Dedicated owners may define species-specific Carry, movement, risk expression, and other traits. fields.label: Exact statement
fields.value: “Yes that's good. Ecology was a layer I didn't fully engage with because I was afraid of letting its biological-strict considerations get into the spec without rogorous evaluation. I think we include as a subsidiary document.”

fields.label: Adopted proposition
fields.value: Ecological Influences is active within a narrow translation scope: qualitative bodily priors, perceptions of safety and movement, ecology-versus-civilization boundaries, and privileged-camera doctrine. Dedicated system owners determine mechanical expression.

fields.label: Normalized ruling
fields.value: Ecology is an `ACTIVE_SUBSIDIARY_OWNER`. fields.label: Authority effect
fields.value: Includes Ecology in the active corpus while preventing biological literalism from silently entering canon.

sections.heading: ## HR-SEM-001 — Semantic Units belong to MEDIAN

fields.label: Status

fields.value: “Verb doesn't enter the namespace. The namespace name is Home.Colony.Practice.Garden, and it's staffed by a Home.Colony.Role.Gardener. All of this happens ‘in DWELL’. In Crossing, it's ‘Away.Crossing.Phase.Observe’ and the act that describes is one of RISK.”

sections.heading: ## HR-SEM-007 — Philosophy is not Architecture
sections.title: Philosophy is not Architecture

fields.label: Class
fields.value: `TERMINOLOGY`

fields.label: Status
fields.value: `SETTLED`

fields.label: Exact statement
fields.value: “For me it was mainly to avoid one word TLD. I don't understand Home as necessarily a SID but Home.Home is explicitly so.”

fields.label: Closing statement
fields.value: “Drop the convention below TLD so Home.Home stays but Home.Colony.Colony loses the dupe?”

fields.label: Normalized ruling
fields.value: A bare Top-Level Domain is a namespace container, not an MSID. Every MSID contains at least two segments. When the broad root concept requires an MSID, it self-roots once, as in `Home.Home`. The repetition convention stops below the TLD; `Home.Colony` is both a valid MSID and a parent branch, while `Home.Colony.Colony` is rejected as empty duplication.

fields.label: Authority effect
fields.value: Establishes the Minimum Two-Segment Rule, TLD self-rooting, and branch-as-unit behavior.

fields.label: Affected sources
fields.value: MSID Grammar; future Semantic Registry; extraction validators.

fields.label: Semantic scope
fields.value: all MSID branches.
